description.describe_ch: 瞭解台灣及國外主要國家退休商品發展與監理之經驗與問題，並規劃如何提升未來商品之具體可行方案及其如何行銷。
description.describe_eh: This course provides students with an understanding of the issues related to the development and Supervision of Insurance Products for Aging Society in Taiwan& major countries, and to plan specific solutions for how to enhance future product and marketing.
